apple.name: CarMazium
apple.subtitle: Buy, Sell & Auction Cars
apple.promotionalText: Sell by free auction or from £1 retail listing. Browse used cars, manage offers and messages, and access dealer tools in one CarMazium account.
apple.description:
CarMazium is a UK vehicle marketplace for adults buying, selling and sourcing used cars.

SELL YOUR CAR
• List a vehicle in a timed auction free of charge as the seller.
• Choose a retail listing from £1.
• Use vehicle lookup, valuation guidance and listing tools to prepare your advert.
• Eligible completed auction sales can qualify for CarMazium's seller incentive after the required handover evidence is approved.

BUY & BROWSE
• Search retail vehicles and live auctions.
• Save vehicles, manage offers and keep transaction-related messages in one account.
• Retail buyers are not charged a CarMazium buyer fee for the vehicle purchase.

DEALER TOOLS
• Approved motor traders can bid in auctions.
• Manage inventory, purchases, offers, customers and business verification from the dealer workspace.
• A successful auction buyer pays CarMazium's applicable platform fee before restricted post-win functionality is unlocked.

PARTNER SERVICES
Eligible business accounts can access CarMazium partner/service workflows, subject to verification and availability.

IMPORTANT
CarMazium is a marketplace and technology platform. Vehicle purchase money is paid directly between buyer and seller; CarMazium does not hold the vehicle purchase price. Auction bidding is restricted to approved motor-trade users. Pricing, eligibility and promotional conditions are shown before the relevant action and may be updated in accordance with the platform terms.

Accounts are for users aged 18 or over.

googlePlay.fullDescription:
CarMazium is a UK vehicle marketplace for adults buying, selling and sourcing used cars.

SELL YOUR CAR
• Free seller entry to timed vehicle auctions.
• Retail listing options starting from £1.
• Vehicle lookup, valuation guidance and listing tools.
• Eligible completed auction sales can qualify for CarMazium's seller incentive after approved handover evidence.

BUY & BROWSE
• Search retail vehicles and live auctions.
• Save vehicles, manage offers and use transaction-related messaging.
• No CarMazium retail buyer fee for the vehicle purchase.

FOR MOTOR TRADERS
Approved motor traders can bid in auctions and use dealer inventory, purchase, offer, customer and verification tools. A successful auction buyer pays the applicable CarMazium platform fee before restricted post-win functionality is unlocked.

CarMazium does not hold the vehicle purchase price. Buyers pay sellers directly. Auction bidding is limited to approved motor-trade users. Pricing, eligibility and promotional conditions are shown before the relevant action and are governed by the CarMazium terms.

Accounts are for users aged 18 or over.
